title: Put your smart home devices on their own network in UniFi
variant: Numbered rail of steps with dark code blocks
prompt: How do I put my smart home devices on a separate network from my laptops, on a UniFi setup?
note: Compact and all sans, with the step numbers in a left rail joined by a line on wide screens so the reader can count where they are, and each step's settings and console checks in a dark code block with the values to change picked out in brand green, because the reader is at a console copying field by field. The one warning-toned callout sits inside the firewall step where people lock themselves out, and a Variations list keyed to steps carries the newer zone-based firewall so the steps do not fork.
